essence: Ego-making arises from intellect-based identifications of I, mine, and this.
Mind is the seed from which determinate and alternative thoughts arise.
The five subtle elements are the causes and objects of hearing and the other senses.
The pentad beginning with pure knowledge consists of both higher and lower power.
The supreme goddess-power bears within herself both the pure and impure paths.
